# Intune Security — CIO / CISO KPI Dashboard

Executive view of Microsoft Intune / MDM risk posture: device trust, compliance, enrollment activity, privileged role exposure, and active threats.

- **CIO view:** device health, compliance %, enrollment throughput.
- **CISO view:** attack surface, suspicious registrations, privileged-role changes, policy tampering.

> IP exclusions use the `NetworkAllowlist` watchlist (CIDR).

content.query:
IntuneDeviceComplianceOrg
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, ComplianceState) by tostring(DeviceId), bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| summarize Devices = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), ComplianceState
| order by TimeGenerated asc

IntuneDeviceComplianceOrg
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by tostring(DeviceId)
| summarize Devices = count() by OS = tostring(OSDescription), ComplianceState
| order by Devices desc

IntuneAuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where OperationName has 'enroll'
| summarize Enrollments = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

IntuneAuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where OperationName has 'enroll'
| summarize Enrollments = count(), LastEnroll = max(TimeGenerated) by User = tostring(Identity)
| top 15 by Enrollments desc

SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend TrustType = tostring(DeviceDetail.trustType)
| where isnotempty(TrustType)
| summarize Devices = dcount(tostring(DeviceDetail.deviceId)) by TrustType
| order by Devices desc

let sensitiveRoles = dynamic(['Intune Administrator','Intune Service Administrator','Endpoint Security Manager','Cloud Device Administrator','Windows 365 Administrator','Security Administrator','Global Administrator']);
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where OperationName has_any ('Add member to role','Add eligible member to role')
| mv-expand TargetResources
| extend RoleName = trim('"', tostring(parse_json(tostring(TargetResources.modifiedProperties))[1].newValue))
| where RoleName has_any (sensitiveRoles)
| summarize Assignments = count(), LastChange = max(TimeGenerated) by RoleName
| order by Assignments desc

IntuneAuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where OperationName has_any ('Delete','Patch')
| where OperationName has_any ('Compliance','Configuration','ConditionalAccess')
| summarize Changes = count(), LastChange = max(TimeGenerated),
            TopOps = make_set(OperationName, 10)
          by Actor = tostring(Identity)
| top 20 by Changes desc

IntuneAuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where OperationName has_any ('wipe','retire','delete','autopilotReset','freshStart','cleanWindowsDevice')
| summarize Actions = count() by Op = OperationName
| order by Actions desc

content.json: ## Active Sentinel incidents from this solution

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Title has_any ('Intune','MDM','Device Registration','Compliance','Conditional Access')
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| summarize Incidents = count() by Severity, Status
| order by Severity asc
